description: This script automates the generation of cryptographic keys and certificates, including RSA and ECC keys, self-signed certificates, and signed certificates by a Certification Authority (CA). It is tailored for setting up a PKI infrastructure, creating keys for CA, intermediate, server, and client entities, and signing certificates appropriately.

methods.name: gen_rsa_key
methods.description: Generates an RSA key pair, saving private and public keys to specified files.

methods.name: gen_ecc_key
methods.description: Generates an ECC key pair, saving private and public keys to specified files.

methods.name: gen_key
methods.description: Delegates key generation to RSA or ECC functions based on KEY_TYPE.

methods.name: ca_sign_self
methods.description: Creates a self-signed certificate for a CA.

methods.name: ca_sign
methods.description: Signs a certificate request using the specified CA.
